title: Comprehensive Ophthalmic Clinical Compendium: Surgical, Diagnostic & Pathological Insights

sections.title: Dacryocystorhinostomy (DCR) Procedural Steps
content: 3. Curvilinear skin incision 1cm from medial canthus 10-12mm in length
4. Dissection down to expose anterior lamellar crest
5. Periosteal incision and elevated to expose lacrimal sac fossa
6. Frontal process of maxila or lacrimal bone removal
7. Creat a bony window to expose nasal mucosa
8. Open lacrimal sac and nasal mucosa
10. Suture posterior flap or skip this step

sections.title: Wegener Granulomatosis: Systemic & Ocular Manifestations
sections.content: Systemic manifestation: Respiratory tract (sinusitis, nasal ulcer, otitis media, airway obstruction, pulmonary infiltrate, nodule, cavitation, alveolar hge), Kidney (glomerulonephritis), Fever, fatigue, weight loss, muscle and joint pain, Skin (purpura, painful skin lesion, ulcer), CNS (meningeal inflammation, cranial palsy, stroke-like symptoms), Heart (pericarditis and other cvs issue). Ocular manifestation: orbital inflammation, scleritis, keratitis, retinal vasculitis, optic neuritis. Drug of choice: glucocorticoids + cyclophosphamide or retuximab.

rows: Cystinosis, Dysproteinaemia, Multiple myeloma, Waldenstrom’s macroglobulinaemia, Hodgkin disease, Leukaemia, Benign monoclonal gamopathy, Cryoglobinaemia, Gold, Bietti peripheral crystalline dystrophy

Pseudophakic bullous keratopathy, Chandler’s syndrome, Posterior polymorphous dystrophy, Central herpetic disciform keratitis, Macular dystrophy, CHED2, Corneal pseudoguttatae (post trauma/inflammation)

sections.title: ERG Abnormalities (Clinical Pearls)
sections.content: Negative ERG (reduced scotopic b-wave, normal a-wave): CRAO, X-linked retinoschisis, Congenital stationary night blindness, Myotonic dystrophy, Melanoma-associated retinopathy, Quinine toxicity, Birdshot chorioretinopathy. Reduced A and B waves: Rod cone dystrophy, Drug toxicity (phenothiazide), Total RD, Cancer-associated retinopathy. Abnormal photopic/normal scotopic: Achromatopsia, Cone dystrophy. Reduced oscillatory potential: Vigabatrin toxicity.

sections.title: Complications of Panretinal Photocoagulation
content: Inadvertent optic disc or foveal damage
Diminished colour vision and contrast sensitivity
Reduced or loss of dark adaptation

sections.title: Key Clinical Concepts (Rapid Fire)
content: Indications for repeating biometry: AL <21.2 or >26, AL difference >0.7, Mean K <41 or >47D, Mean K difference >0.9, Delta K >2.5.
Ischaemic CRVO features: Poor VA, RAPD, Dark deep intraretinal hge, Multiple cotton wool spots, FFA (>10 disc area of capillary non-perfusion), ERG (reduced b-wave).
Aqueous Misdirection: Posterior misdirection of aqueous into vitreous. Risk: Short AL, Nanophthalmos, Uveal effusion, prior AC closure surgery. Treatment: Atropine, IOP lowering, YAG laser, PPV.
Blue Sclera Causes: Scleritis, Osteogenesis imperfecta, Ehlers-Danlos, Marfan, Pseudoxanthoma elasticum, Keratoconus, Keratoglobus, Hyperoxaluria, Nevus of Ota.
